Mechanism: maturity-priced collateral. Each identity stakes basalt, the reserve asset; the minimum voting deposit is one knoll. Weight = stake x tenure; tenure accrues only while the identity signs every round.

Operation: one knoll per vault is enforced on-chain, so stakes cannot split or batch. Tenure resets on re-registration; the garden, the tenured pool, alone may attest and grade.

Attacker cost: each puppet locks its own full knoll; n votes cost n times full price, no bulk discount. Idle farms never mature, re-registering wipes tenure. Marginal cost rises linearly.
